hero.title: Built on experience
hero.lede: Decades of leadership experience provide the foundation for fresh thinking and lasting performance.
hero.imageAlt: A glass-fronted office building reflecting a historic brick facade

story.lede: Epiphanies was founded in 1999 with a simple ambition: to help people think and act profitably.
paragraphs: The name is the promise. The moments that change how someone leads are rarely delivered by a slide deck; they arrive as epiphanies, and our job is to create the conditions for them.

What began as leadership development has grown into executive leadership and consulting across more than 30 countries. In 2023, Nathan Clements joined as Managing Partner after thirty years leading people and transformation for some of Britain’s best-known businesses.

members.name: Dr Dominic Irvine — Founding Partner
members.bio: Performance Consultant and Team Coach to boards globally; doctoral research in elite performance; world-record-breaking ultra-distance cyclist.

members.name: Nathan Clements — Managing Partner
members.bio: Former Group Chief People Officer, SSP Group plc; thirty years leading people, culture and transformation at PepsiCo, Morrisons, Daily Mail Group and Boots; ICF-qualified coach, Tavistock-trained in consulting and change.

members.name: Katrina Harrison — Director of Coaching
members.bio: A seasoned financial services leader and EMCC-accredited coach who guides individuals and organisations through significant change with warmth, clarity and consensus-building skill.

members.name: Sarah Maggs — Director of Performance and Assessment
members.bio: A Chartered Occupational Psychologist with 20+ years’ experience in talent management, assessment and executive coaching for major national and international brands.

members.name: John-Paul Eatock — Director of Leadership Development
members.bio: An energetic, action-focused ICF-accredited coach with senior leadership experience across public and private sectors, known for a supportive "tough love" approach that drives real accountability.

items.title: We meet you where you are
items.body: We take the time to understand your context and ambitions.

items.title: Evidence over fashion
items.body: We use what research shows works, not what’s trending.

items.title: Candour with care
items.body: We say the difficult thing, kindly; clear is kind.

items.title: Practise what we preach
items.body: We test our methods on ourselves first.

items.title: Results that outlast us
items.body: Success is what continues after we leave.

items.title: Lasting partnership
items.body: We stay invested in your success long after the work is done; a sounding board when you need one, not a meter running.

experience.body: We have designed and delivered leadership work in manufacturing, financial services, fintech, insurance, FMCG, retail, media and travel food service, for executive teams, boards and the leaders coming up behind them. And we have led from the inside: Nathan’s executive career includes a $150m organisational redesign, female representation in a top-100 leadership group raised from 22% to 38%, and performance turnarounds in complex, multi-site businesses.

testimonial.quote: “Epiphanies was a strategic advisor and trusted counselor when the BMI Group was going through significant needed transformation. They worked alongside both the Executive Leadership team as well as key Regional leaders and Global function heads. I can highly recommend Epiphanies to any CEO or CHRO looking for trusted inside advisory help and facilitating leadership development”
testimonial.attribution: The testimonial we value most · BMI Group

clients.body: Organisations we have worked with include American Express, BMI, Centrica, Ernst & Young, Heineken, Johnson Matthey, Marks & Spencer, Prudential, Royal Mail, SABMiller, Tetra Pak, Vodafone and Worldpay.
